title: Rustic Fall Fruit Tart
description: Sweetened apples and cranberries are the filling in this rustic fall-fruit tart made with a cream cheese pastry.
ingredients: 4 apples - peeled, cored, and thinly sliced
0.25 cup brown sugar, or more to taste
0.25 cup white sugar, or more to taste
0.33333334326744 cup roughly chopped walnuts, or more to taste

steps.text: Place 2 cups flour in a bowl. Cut butter and cream cheese into flour using a knife or pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse crumbs. Gently mix water into flour mixture until dough forms into a ball.
Mix apples and cranberries with brown sugar, white sugar, 2 tablespoons flour, cinnamon, and nutmeg in a bowl until coated.
Preheat oven to 375 degrees F (190 degrees C). Lightly grease a baking sheet.

Roll dough onto a lightly floured work surface, forming about an 11-inch circle. Transfer dough to the prepared baking sheet. Arrange apple-cranberry mixture decoratively on the dough, leaving a 2-inch rim of exposed dough. Sprinkle walnuts over apple-cranberry mixture. Fold exposed crust up and over the edge of the fruit.
Brush egg over the crust and around the edge of the tart; sprinkle with raw sugar.
Bake in the preheated oven until crust is browned and filling is tender, 30 to 35 minutes.

video.description: If you love pie but don’t mind a more rustic presentation, this easy pastry shell will be a gorgeous presentation of fall fruits. Mix together apples and cranberries with brown sugar, sugar, flour, cinnamon and nutmeg. Then roll a circle of rich pastry made with flour, butter and cream cheese, top with the fruit mixture and chopped walnuts. Fold the dough up over the edge of the fruit and brush crust with egg and sprinkle with raw sugar. Then bake until browned and serve delicious wedges with a dollop of cool whipped cream.
